lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A non-uniform grid of high-luminance circular clusters is distributed posterior to the branchial region. The centroids are organized into roughly vertical columns, with spatial density increasing and individual cluster diameter decreasing towards the dorsal and anterior surfaces.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible traversing the mid-lateral flank, intersecting with the high-intensity centroids to form a series of rectangular grid nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal shelf and a distinct shadow-cast gradient immediately below it.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a distinct transition in patterning, featuring a high-density configuration of micro-spots with significantly smaller pixel-diameters than those found on the lateral flank.
